environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. The upload directory /var/uploads/documents is mounted as an EFS volume shared with a document-processing Lambda. The container runs as root. SERVICE_AUTH_SECRET is set via ECS task definition environment variable (static, rotated manually during deployments). Internal ALB has no WAF attached. The EFS mount has no additional access point restrictions - any file written is accessible to the processing Lambda which executes document conversion using LibreOffice in headless mode.

config.storage: EFS shared mount, no access point file extension filtering
config.network: internal ALB, no WAF, VPC-internal only
config.downstream_processing: Lambda with LibreOffice headless conversion on all uploaded files
